notes: Portable profile entrypoint must parse with POSIX-family shells and Bash when those parsers are available.
CLI dispatcher is pure POSIX sh.
Library files (including lib/cli) are portable core unless a narrower shell-specific path owns them.
Awk compiler is not a shell script; excluded from shell parser validation.
Fish-native library files require Fish parser, not POSIX shells.
System utility modules use portable syntax plus capability gates.
Generic platform capability module must stay POSIX-parse-clean.
macOS modules are platform-gated at runtime but must remain POSIX-parse-clean.
Linux modules are platform-gated at runtime but must remain POSIX-parse-clean.
BSD modules are platform-gated at runtime but must remain POSIX-parse-clean.
